pages.title: Market Sentiment Analysis
pages.text: /* 1. 强制全屏化：清除侧边栏干扰 */ #sidebar, #secondary, .widget-area { display: none !important; } #main { width: 100% !important; float: none !important; margin: 0 auto !important; } .container { max-width: 1600px !important; width: 98% !important; } /* 2. 按钮深度美化：解决白底白字与交互 */ .sentiment-wrapper { text-align: center; padding: 20px; background: #fafafa; border-radius: 15px; } .time-tabs { margin: 0 auto 30px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .tab-btn { padding: 12px 20px; border: 2px solid #eee; background-color: #ffffff !important; /* 强制白底 */ color: #444444 !important; /* 强制深色字 */ cursor: pointer; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .tab-btn:hover { border-color: #26a69a; background-color: #f0fdfa !important; color: #26a69a !important; } .tab-btn.active { background-color: #26a69a !important; color: #ffffff !important; /* 激活时白字 */ border-color: #26a69a; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(38,166,154,0.3); } /* 3. 强制并排布局：解决换行问题 */ .chart-container { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; /* 强制横向 */ justify-content: space-around !important; align-items: center !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; /* 禁止换行，强制并排 */ gap: 20px; width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; /* 若屏幕实在太窄，允许横向滚动而不是换行 */ } .chart-box { flex: 1; min-width: 400px; /* 稍微缩小最小宽度确保并排 */ max-width: 700px; height: 550px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f0f0f0; } 实时 Live 1分钟 15分钟 1小时 1天 1周 1月 (function() { let btcWs, ethWs, charts = {}; const syms = ['BTCUSDT', 'ETHUSDT']; function getOpt(s, n) { return { title: { text: s + ' ' + n + ' 净流入/出', left: 'center', top: '2%', textStyle: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 'bold' } }, tooltip: { trigger: 'item', padding: 10, backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', formatter: '{b}{c} ({d}%)' }, legend: { bottom: '2%', icon: 'circle' }, series: [{ type: 'pie', radius: ['45%', '72%'], itemStyle: { borderRadius: 12, borderColor: '#fff', borderWidth: 4 }, label: { show: true, position: 'outside', formatter: '{b}\n{d}%', fontSize: 13 }, data: [ {value:0, name:'Inflow (Buy)', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}}, {value:0, name:'Outflow (Sell)', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}} ] }] }; } async function up(p) { if (btcWs) btcWs.close(); if (ethWs) ethWs.close(); for (const s of syms) { const c = charts[s]; if (!c) continue; c.showLoading({ text: 'Updating...', color: '#26a69a', textColor: '#26a69a' }); if (p === 'live') { let b=0, se=0; const ws = new WebSocket(`wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/${s.toLowerCase()}@trade`); if (s === 'BTCUSDT') btcWs = ws; else ethWs = ws; ws.onmessage = (e) => { const d = JSON.parse(e.data); d.m ? se += parseFloat(d.q) : b += parseFloat(d.q); c.setOption({series:[{data:[{value:b.toFixed(3), name:'Inflow (Buy)'},{value:se.toFixed(3), name:'Outflow (Sell)'}]}]}); }; c.setOption(getOpt(s, 'Live')); } else { try { const res = await fetch(`https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=${s}&interval=${p}&limit=1`); const data = await res.json(); const k = data[0]; const buy = parseFloat(k[9]), total = parseFloat(k[5]); c.setOption(getOpt(s, p.toUpperCase())); c.setOption({series:[{data:[{value:buy.toFixed(2), name:'Inflow (Buy)'},{value:(total-buy).toFixed(2), name:'Outflow (Sell)'}]}]}); } catch(e) { console.error("API Error:", e); } } c.hideLoading(); } } window.addEventListener('load', () => { syms.forEach(s => { const dom = document.getElementById(s === 'BTCUSDT' ? 'btc-chart' : 'eth-chart'); if(dom) charts[s] = echarts.init(dom); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = function() { document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); this.classList.add('active'); up(this.dataset.p); }; }); up('1m'); // 默认 1分钟 }); })();
